## Model Domain

Describe the physical system or model you would like to see.

## Physical Assumptions

List known assumptions or simplifications.

## Variables

List important variables, units, and operating ranges if known.

## Equations, If Known

Include equations, references, or conceptual rules if available.

## Expected Output

Describe what the example should produce.

## Validation Needs

How could this model be checked? Include boundary cases, conservation rules, known examples, or expected outputs.
